description: backup.run refused as a shape error because its params name an identity key: the actor is stamped by the daemon from the CONNECTION (the kernel's peer credential, the door's ActorFor seam) and never read from params (BK13) — a param that names it would let a caller forge the audit identity of a write to their own data. The refusal happens before the actor is even asked, and the same rejection guards list, verify, status and prune.

error.message: invalid params: backup.run params carry "actor" — the actor is stamped by the daemon from the connection, never named by the caller (BK13)
